Task.Name: Online appointment booking platform
Task.Notes: Agentic SDLC plan generated from a simulation.

Task.Name: Sprint 1
Task.Notes: 2 work items

Task.Name: A1 · User accounts & login
Task.Notes: Deliver "User accounts & login" end to end (sprint 1, size 3/5). ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA 1. Works end to end as described in the spec 2. Automated tests pass in CI 3. No open high or critical security findings 4. Approved at every required human gate 5. Reviewed by at least one engineer

Task.Name: Plan: Planning Agent
Task.Notes: Guardrail: Read-only on code. Write access to the tracker only. Output: Spec + acceptance criteria + task list with estimates

Task.Name: Plan: human review
Task.Notes: Gate: Product owner approves scope and priority. The agent never changes priority.

Task.Name: Design: Architecture Agent
Task.Notes: Guardrail: Proposes only. Cannot merge or change infrastructure. Output: ADR + API contract + diagram + risks

Task.Name: Build: Coding Agent
Task.Notes: Guardrail: Sandboxed workspace, scoped token, PR size limit, no prod access. Output: Small PR with tests, passing CI and a description

Task.Name: Build: human review
Task.Notes: Gate: Engineer reviews and approves every PR.

Task.Name: Secure: Security Validation Agent
Task.Notes: Guardrail: Policy as code. Can block a merge, cannot waive its own findings. Output: Triaged findings + fix PRs + security tests

Task.Name: Secure: human review
Task.Notes: Gate: Security owner approves any high or critical finding and any exception.

Task.Name: Ship: Release & Ops Agent
Task.Notes: Guardrail: No direct prod access. Acts through the pipeline with feature flags. Output: Release notes + canary report + rollback proposal

Task.Name: Ship: human review
Task.Notes: Gate: A human approves production deploys and rollbacks.
